aboutText: Based in Greensborough, Orb Excavations is a Victorian Registered Builder with years of experience in the excavation industry. We specialise in services like limited access excavations, stormwater systems, and foundations, serving the local community with precision and care. Our team is dedicated to providing efficient, sustainable solutions for both residential and commercial projects across Melbourne's north.
servicesText: At Orb Excavations, we offer a comprehensive range of excavation services from site preparation to rock breaking. Based in Greensborough, we handle projects of all sizes with precision and care. Contact us for a free quote on your next excavation need.

services.title: Limited Access Excavations
services.desc: We specialise in excavations for tight and restricted spaces, ensuring precise work without damaging surrounding areas in Greensborough.

services.title: Stormwater & Drainage Systems
services.desc: Expert installation and repair of stormwater and drainage systems to manage water flow effectively on your property.

services.title: Rock Breaking & Drilling
services.desc: Using advanced equipment, we break and drill through rock formations to prepare your site for construction projects.

services.title: Footings & Foundations
services.desc: We lay strong footings and foundations, essential for any building project, with attention to detail and stability.

services.title: Site Clearing & Preparation
services.desc: Full site clearing and preparation services, including vegetation removal and grading, to make your land ready for development.

services.title: Concrete & Pool Removal
services.desc: Safe and efficient removal of concrete structures and swimming pools, clearing the way for new projects in Melbourne.
